shortDescription: New Zealand business confidence eased slightly in August but remained net positive, an ANZ Bank survey showed on Monday.A net 53.7% of respondents expected the economy to improve over the year ahead, down from 56.1% in July.

children: New Zealand business confidence eased slightly in August but remained net positive, an ANZ Bank survey showed on Monday.
A net 53.7% of respondents expected the economy to improve over the year ahead, down from 56.1% in July.
